High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 01. This Misc. Appeal under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act is preferred challenging the award dated 25.09.2018 in Claim Case No.42 of 2017 passed by Member, MACT, Ratlam for enhancement of Rupees One lac compensation.
02. Liability is not disputed so only necessary facts are being discussed.

A compensation of Rs.
5,43,000/- was awarded for the death of Jeevanbai caused due to negligent driving of vehicle No. GJ 17 AH 5342 by respondent No.1, owned by respondent No.2 and insured by respondent No.3,
resulting in the death of Jeevanbai occurred on 04.03.2017 and on that date the age of the Jeevanbai was 59 years 2 months and 3 days and assessing the income of the deceased as Rs. 7,125/- per month applying the multiplier of 9 a total loss of dependency Rs. 5,13,000/- was calculated.

Rupess 15,000/- was for loss of estate and Rs. 15,000/- in the head of funeral expenses wa slaso awarded.
03.
Only two points are to be considered that no amount has been awarded towards the loss of consortium and 10% enhancement for future prospects was not 2 MA-16-2019 added in the income.
04. Accordingly, 1,20,000/- is awarded in the head of loss of consortium (Rs. 40,000/- to each claimants ie. the children of the deceased).
On enhancement of 10% for future prospects a total of Rs. 51,300/- is enhanced in the head of loss of dependency.
05. This appeal is allowed and a total sum of Rs. 1,71,300/- is enhanced with the interest @ 6 % per annum from the date of application i.e 13.04.2017.
The enhanced amount be paid and distributed as per para 24 of the Tribunal.

06. The appellants have valued the appeal only to the extent of Rs. 1,00,000/- and paid the Court fee accordingly, however, for the remaining amount, the Court fee shall be paid by the appellants within a period of one month and thereafter the amount shall be released by the Insurance Company on receiving the certificate.

In case the certificate has not been filed before the Insurance Company up to a period of three months, the claimant shall not be entitled to receive the interest on the Vishnubai vs Suryaveersingh on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158828188/
1
